summary: Tested ElevenLabs Conversational AI Voice Support feature (migrated from OpenAI Realtime API). All backend APIs working correctly (7/7 tests passed). Frontend UI elements (Voice Call button, incoming call overlay, decline button) functioning as expected for Enterprise sites.
critical_code_review_comments: Voice Support router correctly checks clara_enterprise flag before returning signed URL
GET /api/voice-support/signed-url returns wss:// WebSocket URL from ElevenLabs API
VoiceCallWidget.js uses @elevenlabs/react useConversation hook for WebRTC audio
ClaraAssistant.js includes 'Or call Clara Support' button (line 347) that triggers voice call via requestVoiceCall()
MainSiteDashboardLayout.js correctly shows Voice Call button only for Enterprise sites (line 1143-1155)
Voice call context bridge works: ClaraAssistantContext.voiceCallRequested -> MainSiteDashboardLayout -> VoiceCallWidget
seed_data_creation: Created voice support sessions during testing (auto-cleaned by user scope)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Voice Support feature migrated from OpenAI Realtime API to ElevenLabs Conversational AI. Backend tests in test_voice_support_elevenlabs.py cover: signed-url (Enterprise), signed-url (non-Enterprise 403), save-transcript, sessions list, session detail, 404 for nonexistent session, unauthenticated 401. Frontend tests verified: Voice Call button visible for radiogroep (Enterprise), Voice Call button NOT visible for dbntstudio (non-Enterprise), incoming call overlay with ringing animation, decline button closes overlay. ClaraAssistant 'Call Clara Support' button exists in code (line 347) and triggers voice call via context bridge. WebRTC voice streaming cannot be fully tested in headless browser (requires microphone).
